projects.title: SEO Generator
projects.description: An enterprise-grade SEO content cluster generator that researches keywords, builds semantic hub-and-spoke graphs, drafts long-form copy, and injects contextual anchors. Features a contrast-adaptive UI with Minimalist Daylight / Cyberpunk Slate themes, Google SERP preview simulations, and one-click export. Built as part of my Prompt Engineer Internship at Future Intern.
projects.problem: Small businesses and content creators struggled to optimize their content for search engines, leading to poor visibility and low organic traffic.
projects.solution: Developed an AI-powered SEO generator that analyzes blog content and provides actionable optimization suggestions, helping users improve search rankings and drive organic growth.
projects.learnings: Deepened understanding of AI/ML integration in web applications, SEO best practices, and building user-friendly SaaS tools.

projects.title: Website Generator
projects.description: A premier AI-powered platform for generating production-ready React/TypeScript codebases with Tailwind CSS from raw data. Features a Neural Engine Synthesis powered by Google Gemini 1.5 Pro, Aesthetic Matrix UI, and a Blueprint Protocol that takes designs from concept to deployment. Built during my Prompt Engineer Internship at Future Intern.
projects.problem: Local businesses lacked the technical skills and budget to create professional websites, limiting their online presence.
projects.solution: Created an intuitive AI-powered website generator that enables anyone to create a fully functional website through simple prompts and customization options.
projects.learnings: Gained experience in AI-powered code generation, prompt engineering, and building accessible tools for non-technical users.

projects.title: UGC Ad Generator
projects.description: A high-converting UGC ad pack generator for D2C brands and content creators. Features an intelligent Gemini copywriter engine with 5 psychology-triggered hook styles (Vulnerable Confessions, Contrarian Claims, Specific Results, Direct Address, Curiosity Gaps), P.A.S.C. video script framework, and omnichannel adaptation for Instagram Reels, Meta Feed Ads, and YouTube Shorts. Export to PDF, ZIP, or clipboard. Built during my Prompt Engineer Internship at Future Intern.
projects.problem: Brands struggled to create authentic advertising content that resonated with audiences through user-generated content.
projects.solution: Built a platform that leverages AI to generate authentic, user-centric advertising content from UGC sources.
projects.learnings: Learned about content generation pipelines, campaign management systems, and authentic marketing strategies.

projects.title: KeilHQ

projects.solution: Developing KeilHQ to provide AI-powered workflow automation and productivity enhancement tools for modern businesses.

projects.title: PodSoft

projects.solution: Building PodSoft to streamline content creation and distribution through AI-powered tools and smart automation.

projects.title: AI for Energy Consumption
projects.description: Developed insights into scalable solutions for energy-efficient infrastructure management using AI and machine learning techniques. Research project at USCT, GGSIPU.
projects.problem: Data centers and energy infrastructure lacked intelligent systems to optimize energy consumption and improve efficiency.
projects.solution: Applied AI and machine learning techniques to analyze energy consumption patterns and develop scalable optimization solutions.
projects.learnings: Gained expertise in applying machine learning to real-world energy challenges and data center efficiency optimization.

projects.title: Electrochemical Water Splitting
projects.description: Researched hydrogen production methods using electrochemical processes to advance clean energy solutions. Honors research project at USCT, GGSIPU.
projects.problem: Clean hydrogen production methods needed further research to become commercially viable and efficient.
projects.solution: Conducted research on electrochemical water splitting processes to advance hydrogen production technologies for clean energy applications.
projects.learnings: Developed expertise in electrochemistry, experimental research methods, and sustainable hydrogen production technologies.

projects.title: CO₂ Reduction Technologies
projects.description: Investigated innovative approaches for carbon capture and reduction to support climate change mitigation. Honors research project at USCT, GGSIPU.
projects.problem: Rising CO₂ levels required innovative and scalable carbon capture and reduction technologies to combat climate change.
projects.solution: Investigated and analyzed cutting-edge approaches for CO₂ capture and reduction, contributing to climate change mitigation research.
projects.learnings: Deepened understanding of carbon capture technologies, climate science, and environmental impact assessment methodologies.

projects.title: White Hydrogen – Scope in India
projects.description: Explored the potential of naturally occurring hydrogen reserves in India, assessing feasibility and future opportunities for clean energy development.
projects.problem: The potential of naturally occurring (white) hydrogen reserves in India remained largely unexplored and unassessed.
projects.solution: Conducted comprehensive research on white hydrogen reserves in India, assessing their feasibility and potential for clean energy development.
projects.learnings: Gained insights into geological hydrogen systems, energy policy frameworks, and India's clean energy transition landscape.

projects.title: Concierge – Chat Application
projects.description: A cross-device chat application that solves connection issues between multiple devices. Simply login on any device and start chatting to transfer information seamlessly. Built as a real-time communication platform.
projects.problem: Users struggled with fragmented communication across multiple devices, needing a unified chat platform.
projects.solution: Developed a synchronized chat application allowing seamless communication from any logged-in device.
projects.learnings: Mastered real-time WebSocket architecture, device synchronization patterns, and cross-platform state management.

projects.title: Nobel Hub
projects.description: A comprehensive platform to discover Nobel laureate profiles, explore Nobel lectures, breakthrough research papers, and powerful analytics — all in one beautiful interface.
projects.problem: Nobel Prize information was scattered across multiple sources, making it hard to explore comprehensively.
projects.solution: Built a unified platform aggregating laureate profiles, lectures, and research papers with interactive analytics.
projects.learnings: Gained experience in data aggregation, API integration, and building analytics-driven educational platforms.

projects.title: Protein Atlas Prognosis
projects.description: A platform for exploring protein expression data and analyzing prognostic markers in biomedical research.
projects.problem: Biomedical researchers needed accessible tools to analyze protein expression data and identify prognostic markers.
projects.solution: Developed a platform that simplifies protein data analysis and visualization for prognostic research.
projects.learnings: Deepened understanding of bioinformatics, protein data analysis, and scientific data visualization techniques.

projects.title: PodSoft Studio
projects.description: A professional-grade web-based video production and streaming studio inspired by OBS Studio. Features multi-scene management with drag-and-drop sources (Camera, Display Capture, DroidCam via MJPEG), Studio Mode with Preview/Program switching, audio mixer, real-time filters and effects (brightness, contrast), and local recording to .webm via the MediaRecorder API. Includes AI scene analysis powered by Google Gemini.
projects.problem: Content creators needed a professional, browser-based streaming studio without heavy desktop software.
projects.solution: Built a full-featured web-based production studio with OBS-level capabilities including multi-source management, transitions, and AI-powered scene analysis.
projects.learnings: Deep expertise in MediaRecorder API, WebRTC, real-time video processing, and building complex browser-based media applications.

projects.title: Nobel Hub Nexus
projects.description: An enhanced iteration of the Nobel Hub platform with expanded database integration. Features comprehensive Nobel laureate analytics, research paper integration, and an interactive dashboard with PostgreSQL-backed data storage for richer content management.
projects.problem: The original Nobel Hub needed a more robust backend to handle richer data and analytics.
projects.solution: Developed a database-backed enhanced version with PostgreSQL for scalable content management and deeper analytics.
projects.learnings: Gained proficiency in full-stack architecture with PostgreSQL integration, database schema design, and data visualization at scale.
